item.name: 5. Task 3 - Subscriber Queues (Gateway -> Service)  [needs world-service running]
item.description: POST/GET /queues/{service}/{path}: the request joins the queue of the target service; a consumer thread hands it to an instance. Start the target first: docker compose up -d world-service

item.name: 5.1 Queue: request is served through the world-service queue

exec: pm.test("[SUCCESS] 200 OK - world-service answered through the broker queue", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] X-Broker-Queue = 'world-service' (it really went through that service's queue)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Broker-Queue')).to.eql('world-service'));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] X-Queue-Wait-Ms present (time spent waiting in the queue is measured)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Queue-Wait-Ms')).to.exist);
pm.test("[SUCCESS] Handled by a queue consumer thread 'queue-world-service-N'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Broker-Thread')).to.match(/^queue-world-service-/));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] X-Broker-Instance shows which replica served it", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Broker-Instance')).to.include('world-service'));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] Broker /health reports queues.services as an object", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().queues.services).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] A queue named 'world-service' exists after the first queued request", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().queues.services).to.have.property('world-service'));
pm.test("[EXPECTED REJECTION] 401 - queue refuses callers without a token", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("[EXPECTED REJECTION] 404 - no instance of ghost-service is registered", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: 6. Task 3/4 - Topic Queues & GET /topics
item.description: Services fire events on a topic without knowing the subscribers; the broker looks the subscribers up in Service Discovery. 6.2 needs a Service Discovery that supports topics and a service subscribed to ExamPassed.

exec: pm.test("[SUCCESS] Served on its own request thread (req-xxxx)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Broker-Thread')).to.match(/^req-/));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] 202 Accepted - event queued by the broker", () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] publisher = 'player-service' (taken from the token, not from the caller)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().publisher).to.eql('player-service'));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] subscribers is the list of services that registered interest in the topic", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().subscribers).to.be.an('array'));
pm.test("[EXPECTED REJECTION] 400 - topic must start with a letter", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

exec: pm.test("[EXPECTED REJECTION] 400 - event body must be JSON", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("[EXPECTED REJECTION] 401 - only authenticated services may publish", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] queues.topics is reported (one durable-in-memory queue per subscribed service)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().queues.topics).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test("[SUCCESS] Request ran on its own thread named 'req-<id>'", () => pm.expect(t).to.match(/^req-/));
